content: If someone has overdosed and is experiencing severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, immediately call emergency services (911). For other cases of overdose, contact a poison control center without delay. Residents in the United States can call 1-800-222-1222, while those in Canada can call 1-844-764-7669. Store this product at room temperature, ensuring it is kept away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Medications should not be flushed down the toilet or poured into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Dispose of this product properly when it has expired or is no longer needed.
